statements.text: Speculative philosophy is the attempt to frame a coherent, logical, necessary system of general ideas in which every element of experience can be interpreted as an instance of the general scheme. The scheme is judged by whether it is applicable to some items of experience and adequate to all of them.

sources.quote: Speculative Philosophy is the endeavour to frame a coherent, logical, necessary system of general ideas in terms of which every element of our experience can be interpreted.
